vulnerabilities.description: Directory traversal vulnerability in gin-gonic/gin allows attackers to access files outside the intended directory
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update github.com/gin-gonic/gin to version 1.9.1 or later

vulnerabilities.description: Denial of service vulnerability through malformed requests in gin-gonic/gin
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update github.com/gin-gonic/gin to version 1.8.2 or later

vulnerabilities.description: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in axios allows attackers to perform unauthorized requests
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update axios to version 0.21.2 or later

vulnerabilities.description: Command injection vulnerability in lodash allows attackers to execute arbitrary code
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update lodash to version 4.17.21 or later
Update lodash to version 4.17.20 or later

vulnerabilities.description: Off-by-one error in nginx resolver allows attackers to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update nginx to version 1.21.1 or later, preferably 1.25.3 for latest security patches

vulnerabilities.description: Buffer overflow in PostgreSQL allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary code
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update postgres to version 13.3 or later, preferably 15.5 for latest features and security

vulnerabilities.description: Integer overflow in Redis STRALGO command allows denial of service
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update redis to version 6.0.16 or later, preferably 7.2.3 for latest improvements

vulnerabilities.description: Prototype pollution in Node.js allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update node to version 16.14.1 or later, preferably LTS version 20.10.0-alpine

vulnerabilities.description: Unsanitized NUL in environment variables in syscalls in Go allows code execution
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update golang to version 1.19.3 or later, preferably 1.21.5-alpine for latest features

vulnerabilities.description: Inherited from base image golang:1.19.0-alpine - Unsanitized NUL in environment variables
vulnerabilities.remediation: Rebuild with updated golang base image (1.21.5-alpine) and update to v2.4.1

vulnerabilities.description: Inherited from base image node:16.14.0-alpine - Prototype pollution vulnerability
vulnerabilities.remediation: Rebuild with updated node base image (20.10.0-alpine) and update to v3.3.2
